6bx9:
Architectural engineers plan, design, build and maintain the buildings that shape our day-to-day existence with a focus on structural engineering, architectural design and building services.

This accredited course provides the knowledge, skills and hands-on experience. Students will need to become a work-ready architectural engineer. Through laboratory sessions, field trips, individual projects and design classes, they will embed the knowledge gained from there lectures and tutorials and develop their practical abilities in surveying and design.

Students will choose from a range of authentic, real-world engineering problems and industry-focused scenarios, to work on both individually and with student engineers from other disciplines. Group work mirrors the relationships of an engineering team and will help them to build skills in teamwork, project management and communication. Open access makerspace provides a place for them to design, create and collaborate.
6bv0:
The Flagship LLB Law program is a full time, three-year course that is both challenging and stimulating.

Study foundation modules (which constitute the academic stage of training that is currently necessary to become a solicitor or barrister in England and Wales) together with a wide selection of exciting, optional modules that include Environmental Law, Human Rights Law, Media Law and Family Law.

In addition to the broad-based academic training we provide, studying Law at Cardiff will offer students an unique opportunities to see Law in action in a social context.

We are committed to providing an outstanding teaching and learning experience that is underpinned by excellent research activity.

We are the only Russell Group University to offer both courses currently required to qualify as a barrister or solicitor – the Bar Professional Training Course and the Legal Practice Course – which means that they have the option to stay with us in Cardiff to complete their entire legal education.
6by1:
BSc Business Management (International Management) is designed to equip them with practical skills and professional confidence for a successful career in a multinational corporation.

Students will develop international management expertise from the team of researchers and business practitioners. They’ll introduce them to the principles of multiculturalism, ethics and morality and practices like cultural marketing, international business logistics and human resource management.

Their Professional Placement Year is an opportunity to put their university knowhow into practice as they take up a paid role and complement their academic study with exposure to real-world international business scenarios.
6byp:
BSc Accounting and Finance with a Professional Placement Year program is accredited by the Accounting Professional Bodies and is designed to equip them with practical skills and professional confidence for a successful career in accounting and finance-related roles, or in preparation for postgraduate study and research.

On a universal first year, shared with their BSc Accounting program they will develop business and finance expertise from the team of international researchers and qualified accounting professionals. They will be introduced to corporate finance and strategy, markets, institutions and taxation while being encouraged to consider the social, economic and ethical implications of their decisions.

Their Professional Placement Year is an opportunity to put their university knowhow into practice as they take up a paid accounting or finance role and complement their academic study with exposure to real-world business scenarios.
6bxx:
BSc Business Management focuses on organizations of all kinds from multinational corporations to social enterprises and charities. This holistic approach ensures them to develop the skills to respond to the evolving needs of all businesses, irrespective of sector.

Students will develop management expertise from the team of international researchers and business practitioners. They’ll introduce them to disciplines like accounting, digital technology, marketing, human resources and employment, management, and economics.

With their support, students will build a skill set to respond to current developments and challenges in business and society, while preparing to launch a successful career or pursue further postgraduate study and research.
6by2:
BSc Business Management (Logistics and Operations) focuses on organizations of all kinds from multinational corporations to social enterprises and charities. This holistic approach ensures them to develop the skills to respond to the evolving needs of all businesses, irrespective of sector.

They will develop logistics and operations management expertise from the team of internationally renowned researchers. They’ll introduce them to the practices of purchasing and supply, logistics and distribution and advanced operations management.

With their support, students will build a skill set to respond to current developments and challenges in business and society, while preparing to launch a successful career in the logistics industry or pursue further postgraduate study and research.
6bw9:
Brexit and the Bedroom Tax to wages and wealth, environment and energy to health and homelessness, economists have rarely held such influence in the direction and debate of issues affecting the communities of the world.

It’s no wonder then, that employers are offering high wage graduate careers across the public sector, business, banking, accountancy and consultancy for those with economic expertise.

BSc Econ Economics seeks to discover a new generation of economic thinkers.

Research-led faculty will encourage them to consider the social, economic and ethical implications of their decisions on modules in labor economics, development, ethics and morality.

With their support, students will turn theory into practice and seek answers to a range of social and political issues, in preparation for careers in business, banking and consultancy roles or postgraduate and doctoral study.
70hv:
The LLM Bar Training Course offers an intensive, postgraduate-level program for individuals who aspire to become barristers and wish to pursue research at the Master's level. This course is typically taken after completing undergraduate studies and before engaging in work-based learning, known as pupillage.

The program equips students with the necessary skills and knowledge of procedure and evidence to meet the criteria set by the Bar Standards Board (BSB), as outlined in their Professional Statement for Barristers.

The primary objective of our program is to cultivate a professional and ethical approach to practicing as a barrister. Additionally, it provides students with a comprehensive understanding of the daily work and challenges faced by legal professionals in today's world.

Classes are generally scheduled from Monday to Thursday, allowing ample time for personal study. Advocacy and conferencing sessions are conducted intensively in two-hour intervals, with no more than six students per session. Students will also have the opportunity to pursue a specialized advocacy option.

Furthermore, students will be given the chance to undertake the BSB centrally set assessments in December, April, and August during their academic year of enrollment.

Upon successful completion of the program, students will be eligible to be called to the Bar of England and Wales, provided they fulfill the qualifying session requirement of their Inn of Court.
6bz4:
The MA News Journalism program offers individuals the opportunity to acquire the fundamental skills necessary for discovering, producing, and publishing stories using the most effective and relevant tools currently available. In addition to honing their written reporting abilities, students will also gain proficiency in capturing still images and shooting short videos on mobile devices, as well as creating data infographics suitable for uploading to the public-facing news site, The Cardiff an. Furthermore, participants will learn how to effectively promote these stories using various social media platforms.

Throughout the program, students will have the chance to apply their skills outside of the classroom by completing practical assignments that mirror real-world scenarios. These assignments will require them to compile content that reflects a diverse range of stories for both online and print media. Practical work may encompass covering press conferences, public meetings, court proceedings, council sessions, political events, sports competitions, and entertainment functions.

While the program does not seek individuals who are already fully-fledged journalists, it does require applicants to demonstrate a strong interest in news and a genuine commitment to pursuing a career in journalism. This can be evidenced through prior work experience or placements, whether paid or unpaid. It is expected that students remain engaged with current events and demonstrate regular consumption of news through reading, watching, and listening. Such engagement serves as a solid foundation for success in the program.
6bza: The MA Political Communication program aims to deepen students' understanding of political communication in national and international contexts, as well as enhance their skills in this field. Students will have the opportunity to explore the political content of mass media and develop a comprehensive understanding of the individuals and organizations involved in the production of political news and information. The course also examines the impact of media coverage on politics and analyzes the relationship between media systems and political systems, including government media policy, censorship, regulation, and ownership. Students will acquire the necessary research and study skills to conduct project-based professional and academic research. Additionally, the course explores the evolving role of communication in political life, both domestically and globally, and investigates how changes such as the rise of online and social media platforms, image-based politics, and the globalization of media are shaping politics. By utilizing cutting-edge research and case studies, the MA Political Communication program delves into the influence of various actors in the political communications process, including politicians, journalists, and citizens.
6c16:
The LLM International Commercial Law program offered by the institution is widely recognized and highly regarded by leading international commercial law firms. It has gained popularity over the years due to its established reputation.

This program has been specifically designed to cater to the requirements of students and legal professionals who aspire to study commercial law from a global standpoint. It places a strong emphasis on international conventions and agreements, as well as their practical application.

In today's rapidly evolving global economy, commercial law presents both challenges and opportunities. It is crucial to have proficient lawyers who can effectively navigate these challenges and capitalize on the opportunities, especially when providing advice that can have significant financial implications.

The LLM International Commercial Law program offers great flexibility, allowing students to choose from a diverse range of modules. This enables them to tailor the program according to their individual professional and employment needs or personal interests. Some examples of modules offered include Commercial Arbitration, Comparative Corporate Governance, International Commercial Maritime Law, and Insurance Law.
6c1s:
The MSc Accounting and Finance program offers individuals the chance to engage in a comprehensive examination of current accounting and finance matters. This opportunity allows them to contribute to innovative practices across various business sectors, while also recognizing the importance of accounting and finance in fostering a more responsible and sustainable society.

The program acknowledges the fact that individuals will operate within an internationally interconnected, diverse, and constantly evolving environment. To ensure their success in this setting, the program provides exposure to contemporary perspectives and practical experiences. Moreover, it emphasizes the significance of ethical considerations and broader societal concerns, enabling participants to become motivated professionals.
6c2b:
Managers are required to respond to an increasingly intricate global business environment. Contemporary workplaces frequently extend across continents, both online and offline, offering diverse products and services during a period of economic austerity. As a result, organizations are seeking managers who can approach things differently, managers from various locations and professions to spearhead a fresh movement in business.

The responsibility of changing the world lies with them.

The MSc in Business Management program commences by focusing on the individual. Regardless of their background, students are brought up to date on the most recent research and practices in business management, covering fundamental areas such as marketing, strategy, finance, logistics, economics, and human resources.

Experts in the field will assist students in exploring crucial management skills, providing them with a competitive advantage to embark on a successful management career. Utilizing internationally recognized research, these experts will share essential insights into the realm of business and beyond. This research-driven approach to teaching will enable students to assess the social, economic, and environmental consequences of management decision-making across various sectors and international contexts.
6c29:
The Cardiff MBA program is delivered in immersive blocks that are specifically designed to stimulate the curiosity of the students, inform their process of inquiry, and strengthen the application of their learning. Each block of learning consists of a diverse range of activities, such as company visits, industry speakers, time-limited challenges, role-play, and simulations.

The students benefit from small group work and block teaching, which allows them to master specific interdisciplinary approaches before having the opportunity to develop a specialization through the accelerator project. The program concludes with a capstone module that brings together the various areas of expertise acquired throughout the MBA experience.

The diversity of the student cohort and academic staff is considered a valuable asset. Students have the chance to collaborate with their peers, academics, and practitioners in order to challenge their existing knowledge structures, assumptions, values, and skills. This collaborative environment encourages students to reconsider their current understanding and explore issues from different perspectives.

The MBA program is designed to address real-world challenges, and this is reflected in the assessment of the students' work. Similar to the workplace, students are required to complete assessment tasks individually and as part of a team, covering areas such as strategy, personnel, consultancy, innovation, and crisis.

This program structure provides students with the opportunity to customize their MBA experience through six challenge-focused modules, offering flexibility to align with their career aspirations.
6c2a:
The Business Administration with Artificial Intelligence program is designed for individuals like the reader; individuals with relevant work or technical experience, who possess the ambition to accelerate their progression to senior leadership roles through a period of focused study and personal development.

Contemporary integrated themes run through all modules, such as the future of work, responsible leadership, and digital transformation. The reader will also have the opportunity to study a specialist module on Artificial Intelligence, which will be taught within the Data Science Academy in the School of Computer Science and Informatics.

Alongside students from various backgrounds and with diverse experiences, the reader will have the chance to develop their business knowledge, increase their self-awareness, and sharpen their ability as an effective and inspiring leader. They will consider the broader commercial, social, and environmental implications of decision-making in a variety of practical contexts. Additionally, they will have the opportunity to understand the management challenges associated with the application of artificial intelligence and machine learning within business. As a member of the Cardiff Business School community, the reader will benefit from opportunities to make a difference to society and the economy through study and extra-curricular activities in line with Public Value.
